meta.title: 顶配画质的口袋机：索尼RX1RIII上手测试！
meta.title_en: Sony RX1R III: Top-Tier Image Quality in a Pocket

scenes.context: 小小的机身里塞进一块超强处理器，索尼把相机做小是一生的执念。
sentences: 小小的机身塞进超强处理器。
A tiny body packs a mighty processor.
索尼对把相机做小有执念。
Sony is obsessed with making cameras small.
paraphrase: A tiny body packs a mighty processor.
Sony is obsessed with making cameras small.
scenes.speak: A tiny body packs a mighty processor. Sony is obsessed with making cameras small.

scenes.context: 2012年发布第一代大黑卡RX1之后备受好评，第二年追加高像素版RX1R，这一等就是十多年。
sentences: The first RX1 was well received.
Then we waited over a decade.
paraphrase: The first RX1 was well received.
Then we waited over a decade.
scenes.speak: The first RX1 was well received. Then we waited over a decade.

scenes.context: 6100万像素顶配不可更换镜头相机，塞进和A7R5同款顶流CMOS，却焊死卡口配蔡司35F2。
sentences: It pairs with a fixed Zeiss 35mm f/2 lens.
paraphrase: It pairs with a fixed Zeiss 35mm f/2 lens.
scenes.speak: It packs a top-tier 61-megapixel sensor. It pairs with a fixed Zeiss 35mm f/2 lens.

scenes.context: 35毫米焦段拥有目前最顶级全画幅画质，裁切到70mm仍有1500万像素可用画质。
sentences: Cropped to 70mm, it still holds up.
paraphrase: Cropped to 70mm, it still holds up.
scenes.speak: At 35mm, the quality is class-leading. Cropped to 70mm, it still holds up.

scenes.context: 搭载BIONZ XR处理器和AI芯片，运行速度、自动对焦、视频规格都是顶流。
sentences: It runs on the BIONZ XR processor.
自动对焦和视频规格顶流。
Autofocus and video specs are top-tier.
paraphrase: It runs on the BIONZ XR processor.
Autofocus and video specs are top-tier.
scenes.speak: It runs on the BIONZ XR processor. Autofocus and video specs are top-tier.

scenes.context: 更像是全画幅规格下最好的特定化产品：微距焦段、UHS-II卡槽、PD快充、FL系列色彩。
sentences: It supports UHS-II cards and PD charging.
paraphrase: It supports UHS-II cards and PD charging.
scenes.speak: It's a highly specialized tool. It supports UHS-II cards and PD charging.

scenes.context: 极端高画质模式下续航顶不住，出门要带三块电池才安心。
sentences: 高画质模式续航顶不住。
Battery life struggles in high-quality mode.
You need three batteries to feel safe.
paraphrase: Battery life struggles in high-quality mode.
You need three batteries to feel safe.
scenes.speak: Battery life struggles in high-quality mode. You need three batteries to feel safe.

scenes.context: 498克机身里拥有顶级画质，但要接受不可换镜头的现实，选择它的都不是寻常之辈。
sentences: 选择它的都不是泛泛之辈。
Those who pick it know exactly what they want.
know what they want（目标明确）
paraphrase: 用know what they want换一种说法
Those who pick it know exactly what they want.
scenes.speak: Top-tier quality in a 498-gram body. Those who pick it know exactly what they want.

practice: 这台相机在35mm焦段画质顶级，怎么说？
Cropped to 70mm, it still holds up.
You need three batteries to feel safe.

裁切后仍保留可用画质
